name: Reel frame
what: Your video shrinks into a social reel card in the middle of the frame: a top bar and a row of navigation icons frame it, and over your video the reel's own buttons pop in - a heart, comments and share with their counts, a turning music disc, your handle with a Follow pill, the caption and a scrolling music line. The heart gets liked, small hearts float up, and the card grows back to the full frame at the end.
origin: MotionLab's own build after a design in Vibha Ramprakash's claude-video-effects (MIT), 2026-10-28
motion: f0-f12 the companion shrinks the video into the hole (0.4 s, expo-out) and the card's top and bottom bars ride on its edges, the same ease, so card and video move as one; f6-f14 a soft dark scrim fades in at the bottom of the video; the rail's heart, comment, share and more buttons pop in from 50 % (8 f each, 2 f apart from f8, slow end with a small overshoot) with their counts; f10-f20 the handle, Follow pill, caption and music line rise 24 px into place (slow end); f40 the heart is liked: it fills, pops 1.32x and rings out (9 f), three small hearts float up and fade (30 f each, 4 f apart); all the while the music disc turns, the music line scrolls and the progress line fills; the UI fades over 5 f just before the last 0.4 s, when the card grows back to the full frame with the video (ease cubic-bezier 0.33, 0, 0.67, 1)
